question: Does preserving the host product model justify retaining its previous visual theme?
statement: 保护宿主产品模型只保护任务、数据、信息结构、交互和业务语义；旧主题颜色、字体、圆角、阴影与选中态必须单独分类，无业务语义理由时应替换为有证据的品牌样式或中性回退。
appliesWhen: A brand is applied to an existing host UI while its product model must remain unchanged
notFor: Removing business-semantic status colors without review
Treating all neutral baseline styles as old-theme residue
falsificationQuestion: Can an independently approved rebrand intentionally retain high-salience old-theme visuals without a business-semantic reason and still avoid mixed visual authorship?
nextTest: Apply the classification to a different host and brand, then compare business parity and masked first-viewport recognition.

revisionHistory.change: Separated protected host product invariants from replaceable previous-theme appearance after a structurally correct H5 still read as DangoUI.

readerPurpose: 待跨案例验证的宿主保护边界
